page.overview:
Who is Carniele Emares?

Carniele is fair-skinned for a Tairen and has blue eyes and black hair. She is 5'6.5" tall and of medium build.

Carniele has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Since she is of Yellow Ajah, we can assume she has an above average ability at Healing.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the schism.
